The *Kāmakalāvilāsa*,
composed by the venerable Puṇyānandācārya, together with its commentary,
[dedicated to] the illustrious Bhāratadharmamārtaṇḍa, the Great King of Kaśmīra.
At the Pratnavidyāprakāśa (Research) Institute established by the illustrious Pratāpasiṃhavar,

Having collected [the materials] with the assistance of other scholars stationed at the designated office,

Having been thoroughly revised and printed at the Tattvavivechaka Press in Mumbai, it has been brought into publication.
